name: netdust-gates
description: 0.2.0: /plan-review — a fresh plan-reviewer subagent ground-truths the plan's premises against the source before Stefan reads it, files specs/<f>/plan-review.md naming the plan's blob, and the guard refuses product code while a plan open on this branch has no review of its current text. Netdust's software-delivery policy over superpowers: standards injected into the spec and plan, verification by executables (make gate, the shake-out manifest check), authority hooks. Pilot on netdust.be; replaces netdust-agent there and never runs beside it.
